task.title: Managing Your Account
task.shortdesc: Learn how to create a new account, update your profile, and reset your password in .

context.p: Every user needs a registered account. Accounts are managed through the application itself or via the web portal at .
As an administrator, you can manage all user accounts in your organization through the web portal at . For bulk user creation, suspension, and deletion, see .

step.cmd: Launch and click Create Account on the Talk Selection Screen.
Enter your Full Name, Email Address, and a secure Password.
Check your email inbox for a verification message and click the confirmation link.
Return to and log in with your new credentials.

result.p: Your account is now active. You can join or create talks immediately.

step.cmd: Click your avatar or username in the top-right corner of the application.
Select Edit Profile from the drop-down menu.
Update your Display Name, Avatar, or Status Message as desired.
On the Talk Selection Screen, click Forgot Password?.
Enter the email address associated with your account and click Send Reset Link.
Open the password reset email and click the link provided.
Enter and confirm your new password, then click Reset Password.
Log in to using your new password.

result.p: Your password has been updated. All active sessions on other devices will be signed out automatically.
